is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles sinensis and Anopheles vagus.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports Vgsc L1014F (L995F) and Ace-1 G119S (G280S).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 provides genotype counts (TTG/TTG, TTG/TTT for kdr; GGC/GGC, GGC/AGC, AGC/AGC for ace-1) for An. sinensis.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Hainan Island, China, which is not in Africa.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study collecting and testing mosquitoes from the field.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies collection sites including Sanya, Baoting, Chengmai, Dingan, and Tunchang.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study states collections were made in July–August 2012.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes original field collections in 2012.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigates insecticide resistance in Anopheles sinensis and Anopheles vagus from Hainan Island, China. It reports resistance to DDT, deltamethrin, and malathion, and genotypes for kdr (L1014F) and ace-1 (G119S) mutations. The study is ineligible because it is not based on African field populations.
exclusion_reasons: The study was conducted in China, not Africa.
